modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On March 31, 2005: The dwarf planet Makemake is discovered by a team led by astronomer Michael E. Brown at the Palomar Observatory.
On March 31, 1966: The Soviet Union launches Luna 10 which later becomes the first space probe to enter orbit around the Moon.
On March 31, 1958: In the Canadian federal election, the Progressive Conservatives, led by John Diefenbaker, win the largest percentage of seats in Canadian history, with 208 seats of 265.
On March 31, 1951: Remington Rand delivers the first UNIVAC I computer to the United States Census Bureau.
On March 31, 1918: Daylight saving time goes into effect in the United States for the first time.
